title: C: Union Types
description: Use a union to store and interpret the same memory as different types (int, float, and unsigned char bytes).

steps.title: Union Type Punning
steps.description: Define a union `Data { int i; float f; unsigned char bytes[4]; }`. Store an integer value 0x3F800000 (which also represents 1.0f as float) and print the int, float, and each byte in hex.
hints: All union members share the same memory.
Write to one member, read from another.
Use `%02x` format to print hex bytes.

verification.failureMessage: Print int, float, and bytes interpretation of the same memory
